source_en: Returning home after a morning shift at the care facility.
Resident returning from nursing school.
Home to Grandma in the southern block. Her pills are at noon.
Collecting medication from the district supply depot.
Morning rotation at the care home. Home for Grandma's pills.
Checking on elderly residents in the residency wing.
Returning to registered residence for the mandatory lockdown.
Bringing medication to my grandmother in the southern block.
Fulfilling mandatory healthcare worker check-in.
Collecting my nursing pension after thirty years' service.
Home to my parents' flat in the north district.
Giving a talk on why astrology is unscientific.
Back from the operating theatre. I'm head surgeon there.
Grandma moved to the coast. I'm alone in the flat now.
Collecting my grandson from school.
Collecting my retirement medal. Forty years in nursing.
Selling my grandmother's sewing machine. She never sewed.
Never worked in health care. Going home to rest.
Here are my papers. Sorry, I know I look tired. The energy in the ward has been really heavy lately.
The universe keeps asking us to carry more than we think we can. I’m learning to hold.
Good morning. I keep my documents in my grandmother's prayer book. For protection.
My hands are a little shaky today. The air quality, I think. Or mercury retrograde.
The patients are scared. I keep telling them to breathe through it. Sometimes I almost believe myself.
I’ve been burning sage in the stairwell. My neighbor says it helps with the radiation. I think he might be right.
Everything feels like it's vibrating at a very strange frequency right now.
I’m just trying to stay grounded. My grandmother always says... sorry. I’m just very tired.
The light in here is very harsh. Does it bother you? I think it disrupts the pineal gland.
Thank you. Sending you good energy for your shift.
Be well. Drink water. The body always knows what it needs.
Thank you. I’ll try to remember to breathe.
Oh. Okay. Can someone check on my grandmother? She needs her medication at noon.
I understand. It’s alright. Everything happens for a reason.
Please. Someone needs to bring Grandma her pills. Please.
The universe… it wasn’t… I thought…
Grandma… I’m so sorry… I tried…
It’s okay… everything is… connected… even… this…
Okay. Okay. I’m trusting the process. I’m trusting the process.
Can someone just please check on Grandma? She needs her pills at noon.
The universe has a plan. It has a plan. I’m choosing to believe that right now.
The universe was supposed to… I thought if I just… stayed aligned…
Grandma… please… someone take care of… Grandma…
It’s alright… it’s all energy… it doesn’t disappear… it just… changes…
Where are you coming from?
Morning shift at the care home, then a lecture at the nursing school. Now home to Grandma. Her pills are at noon.
The district supply depot. Three hours in line for Grandma's medication. The energy in there was very heavy.
The southern block, bringing Grandma her pills. Then the clinic. Back and forth all day. I am just very tired.
The children's hospital. I work the maternity ward. Newborns have such pure energy.
My flat near the university. I live alone. It is good for my practice.
Grandma's grave. She passed in the summer. I go every day to talk to her.
Are you experiencing any symptoms?
Some fatigue. The ward energy is heavy. I meditate more to compensate. The body knows what it needs.
My hands shake in the mornings. The air, I think. Or mercury retrograde. It settles after my tea.
Night sweats. My hands. Some gaps in my memory. I think the mind is just protecting itself right now.
Nothing. My hands are perfectly steady. They always have been. Look.
I feel wonderful. I have not worked a shift in weeks, so I have really been resting.
Totally balanced. I am thirty-five now. I have learned to listen to my body.
Good energy at this post today. I mean that literally, I can feel it.
Are you hydrated? You look dehydrated. The body always knows what it needs.
I have been burning sage in my building. My neighbor thinks it helps. I do too. Mostly.
Breathe through it, officer. That is what I keep telling my patients.
My hands shake a little in the mornings. Mercury retrograde, probably.
I told myself today would be easier. The universe is still working on it.
I am just trying to stay grounded. My grandmother says that a lot. It helps.
The frequency in this air is very strange right now. Can you feel it?
I am fine. I say that to everyone. I am still deciding if it is true.
